notes: This registry records what the historical implementation attempted; it does not establish question-level conceptual equivalence.
Every record still requires exact EPH and CPV-2010 question, universe, reference-period and category evidence before external Census use can be approved.
Asymmetric or lossy recodes are recorded as ambiguity rather than silently treated as invertible mappings.
